name: sendit
description: Temporary file sharing from a Windows PC

scripts.build: tsx scripts/clean.ts && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsx scripts/build_assets.ts
scripts.test: npm run build && tsx --test src/protocol.test.ts src/transfer.test.ts src/tunnel.test.ts src/installer.test.ts src/server.test.ts src/client/channel.test.ts src/client/selection.test.ts
scripts.test:stress: npm run build && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/client/selection.stress.test.ts src/server.stress.test.ts
